description:
Advances: specled.api_boundary

Review-bar-override: seeding-after-detection changes first-run semantics — needs a spec decision + ADR, not an edit.

From the critical review of specled_-n5q (finding F4, Medium, security reviewer).

Seeding runs BEFORE detection and is not divergence-gated, so a run against a stale or cold _build can write an entry labeled resolved_via: "source" for a binding that production resolves via beam. Once written, every subsequent run diverges against it — and divergence blocks the refresh, so the entry can never be rewritten. Permanently stuck.

Why it could not land on the release branch: the narrow discriminator (refuse to seed when resolution looks beam-missing) is provably wrong — a legitimate private-function binding and a stale-beam miss both present as "module loaded, function_exported?/3 false, [:beam_fn_missing]". Refusing on that signature would refuse 14 of this repo own 173 entries.

The viable fix is to seed AFTER detection, which changes first-run seeding semantics: the detector currently reads the store post-seed, so a first-run binding produces no finding by construction. That is a spec decision plus an ADR, not an edit.

## ORCHESTRATOR CONTRACT (specled_-i4x)

Advances: specled.realized_by

(CORRECTED by orchestrator — the ticket said specled.api_boundary, which is wrong. The
requirement constraining seed ordering is specled.realized_by.silent_seed,
.spec/specs/realized_by.spec.md:266-278. Nothing in api_boundary.spec.md mentions seeding.)

BLOCKED BY specled_-vzd.2, so this ticket's gate is written against final refresh semantics.
Both edit orchestrator.ex in the do_run/2 gate region ~20 lines apart.

RE-CHARTERED BY THE OPERATOR. THE TICKET'S OWN PRESCRIBED FIX DOES NOT FIX THE STATED DEFECT —
do not implement what the original body says. On a seeding run there is no committed entry,
hence no divergence finding for that MFA, hence a PER-MFA divergence gate never fires and the
stale resolved_via: "source" label is written exactly as before. Moving the seed after detection
is also finding-neutral on its own: every detector already returns [] on a missing baseline
(api_boundary.ex:110-111, expanded_behavior.ex:132, typespecs.ex:119, use.ex:154,
implementation.ex:177 and :240), so there is no first-run semantics change to trade against.

IMPLEMENT THIS INSTEAD — A RUN-SCOPED GATE: if this run emitted ANY
branch_guard_resolution_path_divergence finding anywhere, the tree is cold — seed nothing new
this run. That is the only reading under which the defect actually closes.

Scope-correcting note for the ADR: "permanently stuck" as the ticket words it is overstated.
path_divergence_finding/4 (lib/specled_ex/realization/api_boundary.ex:222-224) already documents
entry deletion as the remedy. State the real severity — a stale label that survives until
someone deletes the entry — rather than inheriting the ticket's framing.

DECISION-CLASS: yes. Draft fully and record completion normally; the orchestrator will NOT merge
without human sign-off.

Allowed touches:
- lib/specled_ex/realization/orchestrator.ex
- .spec/specs/realized_by.spec.md
- .spec/decisions/specled.decision.*.md  (one new ADR)
- test/specled_ex/realization/orchestrator_test.exs
- test/specled_ex/realization/implication_integration_test.exs
- .spec/specs/branch_guard.spec.md  (surface owner of orchestrator.ex, branch_guard.spec.md:24)
- .spec/realization_hashes.json  (escape hatch only)
Note: editing orchestrator.ex without touching branch_guard.spec.md emits
branch_guard_missing_subject_update at WARNING (not pinned to error in .spec/config.yml).
Non-blocking, but the touch is expected by convention.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/specled_ex/realization/api_boundary.ex, hash_store.ex, implementation.ex
- docs/**
- lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex

Out of Scope (intent):
- No "refuse to seed when resolution looks beam-missing" discriminator. The ticket already
  refutes it: a legitimate private-function binding and a stale-beam miss both present as
  [:beam_fn_missing], and refusing on that signature would refuse 14 of this repo's own 173
  entries.
- Do not touch comparable?/2 (api_boundary.ex:185-189) or unlabeled-baseline legacy semantics —
  settled by specled.decision.resolution_path_provenance point 2.
- Do not widen into per-MFA refresh scoping. That is specled_-vzd.2, which lands before you.
- Do not bump @hasher_version (hash_store.ex:35). ADR point 5 rules it out.

Verification:
  mix compile --warnings-as-errors
  mix test test/specled_ex/realization/orchestrator_test.exs \
           test/specled_ex/realization/implication_integration_test.exs \
           test/specled_ex/realization/implementation_test.exs
  mix test --only spec:specled.realized_by.silent_seed
  mix format --check-formatted
  make xref
  bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh
STUB FLIP REQUIRED: in .spec/specs/realized_by.spec.md the tagged_tests block covering
silent_seed + silent_seed_uses_merge is execute: false. The tagged tests already exist
(implementation_test.exs:786 and :808; implication_integration_test.exs:362-363;
hash_store_test.exs:305, :322, :348, :373). Flip it to execute: true and prove it green.

Expected diff: 5-7 files, ~200 lines (ADR ~90, spec ~10, orchestrator ~30, tests ~70).

They cannot disagree within a run — exactly one of the two paths is live per run — but it is a second reading of the same question, the drift-hazard shape this ticket was told to avoid for the divergence set. Cheap to unify later.
4. `mix test --only spec:<id>` silently selects nothing for any multi-element list `@tag spec:` in this repo (see above). Worth a separate ticket if the contract-level "prove it by tag" instruction is going to keep being issued — it is a trap for future implementers and verifiers, not a defect in this diff.

- TICKET'S ORIGINAL PER-MFA FIX mutant: RED — the test DOES pin the re-charter. I implemented the ticket's original prescription literally: seeding moved post-dispatch, `seed_uncommitted_hashes/4` threaded `diverged_tier_mfas` and rejecting only bindings whose own `{tier, mfa}` carries a divergence finding; refresh exclusion left at `diverged_tier_mfas` (no run-scoped widening). Same assertion at :1680 fails with `resolved_via: "source"`. `uncommitted_mfa` has no finding of its own, so the per-MFA gate lets it through and the cross-binding property catches it. A future "simplification" back to per-MFA goes red.

- Over-correction mutant (`seed_allowed? = false`, never seed): RED, 11 failures — including the new test itself (its inline control block asserts the clean-run seed still writes `resolved_via: "source"`), plus 10 pre-existing silent-seed / hash-commit tests. "Clean runs still seed" is pinned, and pinned inside this test, not only by neighbours.

- Observes the WRITTEN baseline, seed path specifically: yes. Every assertion goes through `HashStore.read(root)` -> `read_raw/1` -> `File.read("<root>/.spec/realization_hashes.json")` (`hash_store.ex:208`) — disk, no cache layer. No vzd.4-style masking: the assertion is `== nil`, i.e. NEITHER write path touched the entry, which is strictly stronger than checking a post-refresh label. Proven live by mutant 1/2 (seed path leaks -> red) and by a bonus mutant that kept the run-scoped seed gate but dropped the new `uncommitted_flat_tier_mfas` refresh exclusion — also RED, so the test closes the refresh-path bypass too. I additionally probed each "must not be seeded" assertion independently (disabling earlier ones in scratch so later ones are reached): all three are live — `api_boundary/uncommitted_mfa` (cross-binding, same tier), `api_boundary/uncommitted_bare_module` (head-union seed), and `implementation/uncommitted_bare_module` (cross-tier, no finding of its own). None vacuous.

- vzd.2's regression test still passes and pins a different property: yes — "a divergence excludes its tier/MFA but refreshes unrelated flat-tier entries" (:1713) is green in every pristine run. It pins REFRESH scoping over COMMITTED entries (diverged entry untouched, clean same-tier sibling relabeled to beam, clean `expanded_behavior` entry de-stale-markered, attestation exclusion, and identical behaviour under `--accept-drift`). The new test pins SEED gating over MISSING entries. No contradiction; the only overlap is the new test's `committed_clean_mfa` relabel/stale-marker assertions, which serve as its non-vacuousness anchor (they prove the run was not wholesale blocked) rather than duplicating vzd.2's scope.

- Fixture hygiene: per-test `root` from the module `setup` — `System.tmp_dir!()` + `:erlang.unique_integer([:positive])`, `on_exit(fn -> File.rm_rf!(root) end)` so cleanup runs on failure too. No baseline leakage into the repo (all writes under the tmp root). Collision risk with the other 50 tests: none observed — module is `async: false`, roots are unique, and the two fixture modules (`ColdDiverged`/`ColdUncommitted`) are names used nowhere else and are never compiled/loaded (resolution is deliberately `:source` via the manifest, guarded by `assert Binding.resolution_path(uncommitted_ast) == :source`). One nit, non-blocking: the test writes `cold_seed_gate_fixtures.ex` into the SHARED `setup_all` fixture_dir and never removes it; harmless today (no other test globs that dir — `fixture_dir` is referenced only at :1605/:1606 — and `setup_all`'s `on_exit` rm_rf's the whole directory), but it is a shared-state write in an otherwise per-test-isolated file. `@tag spec:` is a 2-element list; `mix test --only spec:specled.realized_by.silent_seed_run_scoped_divergence_gate` selects 0 tests as expected for this repo, but that is NOT a verification gap here: `SpecLedEx.TaggedTests.build_command/2` resolves cover ids to FILES, and I confirmed `TagScanner.scan(["test"])` does surface the id (file/test_line 1604) and builds `mix test ... test/specled_ex/realization/orchestrator_test.exs` — the whole file runs, so the `execute: true` block genuinely executes this test.

- Sweep: no `Process.sleep`. No implementation-detail assertions — everything is either the returned findings list or the on-disk baseline JSON. No vacuous assertions found (all three nil-assertions independently proven live; the divergence-fired `Enum.any?` guard and the `resolution_path == :source` precondition both prevent the nil assertions from passing for the wrong reason).

Verdict rationale: the test pins exactly the cross-binding, cross-tier property the re-charter turns on — it kills the pre-ticket revert, the ticket's ORIGINAL per-MFA gate, a refresh-path bypass, and the never-seed over-correction, and its own inline control keeps the clean-run seed honest. Assertions read the written `.spec/realization_hashes.json` off disk with `== nil`, so a leaked seed cannot be masked by a downstream refresh. Only nit is the unremoved write into the shared setup_all fixture dir, which is contained by that dir's own teardown and blocks nothing.

title: Baseline seeding is not divergence-gated: a stale _build can write a permanently-stuck source label
